Summary: The ManuRAG dataset includes 309 MathQ mathematical QA pairs and 471 MCQ multiple-choice questions, both focused on manufacturing principles and practices. The MathQ category requires factual accuracy and often involves multi-modal data interpretation, while the MCQ category tests conceptual understanding with distinct choices and explanations. The dataset also includes 735 RQ review-based questions focusing on textual comprehension.
